title: My First Week at College
text:
Hello, my name is Lucas and I started university last month. On the first day I was very nervous. My classes were in a big building, and I got lost twice. But the students were very friendly, and they helped me find the library.

Now I study every day in the library after lunch. My favorite class is biology, because the teacher shows us amazing experiments. I want to be a doctor one day. Thank you for reading my blog, and please write a comment below.

questions.text: How did Lucas probably feel after the students helped him find the library?
What does Lucas probably want to do in the future?

a place where people can borrow and read books
kind and pleasant to be with

paragraph_translations: Olá, meu nome é Lucas e comecei a faculdade mês passado. No primeiro dia eu estava muito nervoso. Minhas aulas eram em um prédio grande, e eu me perdi duas vezes. Mas os estudantes foram muito simpáticos e me ajudaram a encontrar a biblioteca.

Agora estudo todos os dias na biblioteca depois do almoço. Minha aula favorita é biologia, porque o professor mostra experimentos incríveis. Quero ser médico um dia. Obrigado por ler meu blog e escreva um comentário abaixo.
